name: Whisparr Sync
summary: Keeps Cove in step with the Whisparr instance you configure, calling out to it with an API key you supply and Cove holds server-side. One endpoint answers anonymously — the import callback Whisparr posts to — and it is authenticated by a secret this extension mints rather than by a Cove permission; every other endpoint requires one. The connection and sync surfaces are still being built.
